Hi Tom  appreciate the questions. Short answers and what I'll provide ahead of the 4/28 call: 

SOC 2 / audit evidence
- Redwood holds a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the inference control plane and associated operational processes. I will attach the SOC 2 summary and the auditor contact in a secure data room.
- Complementary user-entity controls: we document the control set customers are expected to maintain (network segregation, key management in customer VPC, identity providers). We can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter and a list of artifacts (logs, change control records) that we can produce under NDA.

Private/VPC deployment details
- Customer-owned VPC (preferred): we deploy connector infrastructure into your account (CloudFormation/Terraform modules) that creates private subnets, interface endpoints, and a set of managed ENIs for our service. No public ingress.
- Redwood-managed private VPC: we can host isolated subnets in our cloud account with strict peering and private link access.
- Networking controls: egress can be restricted via NAT/Egress gateways, and we support blocking public egress and routing through customer-managed proxies. KV cache: encrypted at rest and in transit; you can opt to colocate caches in your region to avoid cross-region replication.

Air-gapped / on-prem options
- We offer a full-stack on-prem deployment kit (containerized runtime + orchestration) that can run in an air-gapped environment. It requires a one-time image import process and an offline licensing step. It is heavier from an ops perspective; we'll share the deployment checklist.

Vendor Security Questionnaire (SSQ)
- We can initiate the SSQ today. If you can upload your questionnaire (Doc or XLS), we will assign an owner and return answers + evidence links within 5 business days for standard questionnaires.

Attachments I'll share now (in secure folder):
- redwood-soc2-summary.xlsx (attached in this thread)
- redwood-private-vpc-deployment-diagram.pdf
- vendor-security-questionnaire-initiation.docx (template for kickoff)

I'll be on the call 2028-04-28 11:00 AM ET to go into detail and gather any additional items.

Regards,
